claim_boundary: research-only external benchmark dossier; no production superiority claim; no raw TCPD series redistribution; Nemenyi non-separation is inconclusive

change_log.note: Rank, score, confidence intervals and pairwise arithmetic remained stable; only claim discipline was made explicit.

change_log.change_scope: headline field made self-contained; full pairwise table, frame reconciliation and Friedman/Nemenyi result surfaced
change_log.note: The current artifact sha256 is the root sha256 field; it is not embedded here to avoid self-referential hashing.

headline_claim.frame_reconciliation: earlier successful-rows frame rank 6 lies within the paired-frame rank CI [1,7]; the frames are consistent and the paired frame removes missing-row selection effects.
headline_claim.friedman_nemenyi_read: Friedman p=1.217e-38; Nemenyi CD95=3.625; non-separation is INCONCLUSIVE_NOT_EQUIVALENCE, not equality or superiority.
headline_claim.headline_basis: default_f_measure on all_42 paired common-dataset frame

oracle_handling.common_set_warning: Default and oracle common sets differ; 35 default common datasets versus 37 oracle common datasets, so ranks are not directly comparable across modes.
oracle_handling.reason: Oracle scores use answer-visible upper-bound framing and are secondary only.

publication_rules: headline may cite default ranks only, never oracle ranks
rank must be printed with bootstrap rank CI
score must be printed with bootstrap score CI
pairwise SAA-minus-top-method CI and W/T/L must be printed near the headline
Friedman/Nemenyi must be printed with INCONCLUSIVE_NOT_EQUIVALENCE caveat
default and oracle frames must not be compared directly because their common-set denominators differ
real-world 37 subset must be printed as a stability check, not as a cherry-picked replacement frame
headline_claim.published_headline: default F-measure paired common-set rank 4/15 (CI95 1-7) on 35 of 42 paired datasets
headline_claim.real_world_stability: real-world 37 stability: default F rank 4/15 on 30 of 37; default covering rank 5/15 on 30 of 37; all_42 covering rank 5/15.
